universes.name: MCU / Earth-616
universes.description: The main Marvel Cinematic Universe continuity, from Iron Man (2008) onward. Confirmed designation per Kevin Feige and Marvel's Timeline Book.

universes.name: Fantastic Four Universe
universes.description: A visually distinct, retro-futuristic timeline shown in The Fantastic Four: First Steps, explicitly separate from Earth-616 per official statements and period styling.

universes.name: Fox X-Men Universe (legacy 20th Century Fox continuity)
universes.description: The pre-Disney-acquisition X-Men film continuity (2000-2020), including the Deadpool films. Folded into the broader multiverse conceptually via Deadpool & Wolverine.
universes.confidence: OFFICIAL (for films' own continuity); INFERRED (for multiverse folding mechanism)

universes.name: Raimi Spider-Man Universe
universes.description: Sam Raimi's Spider-Man trilogy (2002-2007), referenced and visited in Spider-Man: No Way Home via multiversal breach.

universes.name: Webb Spider-Man Universe (The Amazing Spider-Man)
universes.description: Marc Webb's Amazing Spider-Man films (2012-2014), similarly referenced and visited in No Way Home.

universes.name: TVA-observed Multiverse / Sacred Timeline branches
universes.description: The branching timeline structure established in Loki, where the Sacred Timeline (Earth-616) spawns infinite branches after He Who Remains' death; Loki now stewards these branches as of Loki Season 2.

unconfirmed_universe_numbering: This research does NOT assign specific numeric universe designations (e.g., Earth-838, Earth-199999) beyond what Marvel has itself officially confirmed, to avoid inventing unverified classifications.
convergence_mechanism_status: UNKNOWN — Marvel Studios has not officially detailed the exact mechanism by which the Fox X-Men universe and the Fantastic Four universe converge with Earth-616 in Doomsday.
